questions.questionText: In a Venn diagram, Surgeons are inside Doctors, and Doctors are inside Humans (three nested circles). Which of the following conclusions definitely follows?
questions.explanation: Read the diagram: Surgeons are inside Doctors, and Doctors are inside Humans (three nested circles). Only 'All Surgeons are Doctors' is true in every such drawing; each of the other statements contradicts the picture.
questions.shortcut: Check each statement against the circles: inside → 'All', separate → 'No', overlap → 'Some'.

questions.questionText: Among 120 employees of a Pune IT firm, 79 know Java and 91 know C++. Some may know neither. What is the minimum possible number who know both?
questions.explanation: Minimum overlap occurs when the union is as large as possible (120): both ≥ 79 + 91 − 120 = 50.
questions.shortcut: Min both = A + B − Total (if positive).
